title: Implement in-memory LogStorage for testing
description:
Implement MemLogStorage: a HashMap-based in-memory implementation of LogStorage. Thread-safe via tokio::sync::RwLock. Suitable for deterministic unit tests without SQLite. Artifact: core/src/group_log/mem_storage.rs.

Acceptance: all LogStorage methods implemented and pass a shared test suite; insert/get/tips roundtrip correctly; concurrent inserts do not deadlock
